title: A son, Saʿd, is born to Yūsuf and Sayyida of Fezzan
The same day a Naṣrid betrothal is agreed with the Marīnids of Morocco
Another landing at Cagliari thrown back
Aragon sinks the fleet of the Sahel in the gulf of Cagliari
A Tunisian squadron worsted off Cape Ben Sakka
The Black Death arrives: the pestilence rumoured out of the east two years before comes to the realm, in the middle of the war with the three crowns
source: Trent's account (the year follows from the saves: in September 1347 the plague had touched nowhere in Iberia)

title: The infected are segregated: the crown answers the pestilence by separating the sick from the healthy

data.effects: disease resistance +15%; burgher and commoner satisfaction −5%; drift toward communalism

source: Trent's account (after the plague's arrival; the exact day isn't given); effects from the game files

title: In the far-flung villages the elders present scapegoats for the plague, despite the government's attempts to stop it
source: Trent's account (after the plague's arrival; the exact day isn't given)

title: A Castilian force of 2,750 destroyed before Qurṭuba
After prayers at El-Mnṣura a madman falls on the amir with a blade. Yūsuf survives, scarred; some at court whisper that his guards were drawn away by those who oppose his rule
source: Trent's account and his screenshot of the event

title: Morocco's great fleet of 54 ships falls on Aragon off Cape Ben Sakka and sinks 13 of its 16

Yūsuf sends a delegation to Kostantîniyye to congratulate the Ottomans and ask for soldiers against the crowns of Iberia; after a decade of friendship, Süleyman Bey refuses: 'Why should we try to rekindle a nearly extinguished flame?'
For the first time Morocco's influence over Granada passes Castile's (+8.8), while the attempt on the amir, the war and the plague drive sovereignty down to 39.7
The plague is in Huéscar, Yuz Aryuba and Antaqīra, and in Shāṭiba and Gandia of Balansiyya; the realm has lost 17,000 souls since September
The war is costing 50 a month against an income of 19; five loans are owed, 127 in all, and the treasury holds 819
The Plague of Wage Fixing: with labour short, the guilds hold wages down and their members grumble; the crown sides with the guilds, and the ungrateful labourers are shown their place

data.choice: The ungrateful laborers must be shown their place
data.effects: pop satisfaction −10% in Muyaqar and its neighbours, and (hidden) across the realm

source: Trent's screenshot of his choice; effects from the game files

title: Physicians warn that half the medicaments in the markets are expired or cut with filler and may spread the plague; the amir orders them burned
Portugal makes a separate peace with Morocco and leaves the war: it annuls every treaty with Castile for ten years, pays war reparations, and gives 142 gold to Morocco and its allies

terms: Portugal annuls all treaties with Castile for 120 months
Portugal pays war reparations to Morocco
Portugal gives 142.03 gold to Morocco and its allies
